Colts vs Texans DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, November 19 · NFL Week 11 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 19, 7:24 PM ET

C.J. Stroud has the highest SPAGS projection in the Colts at Texans DraftKings Showdown: 20.7 points at $10,000 FLEX, 31.0 at captain for $15,000. Across 100,000 simulations Stroud holds 84% of the winning-lineup credit.

He also has the largest captain share: 22.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Stroud at captain. Nico Collins is the next captain in line, at 16.7%. The model gives him 7.4 targets on 27.7 routes.

Houston is a 12.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 28.5 for the Texans and 16 for the Colts.

Behind Stroud and Collins, the next projections are David Montgomery (15.6, $8,200), Jonathan Taylor (15.3, $10,600) and Daniel Jones (12.7, $8,800).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 19, 7:24 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: C.J. Stroud, HOU QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

C.J. Stroud holds 22.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 20.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 31.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 100,000 simulations Stroud averaged 20.7 points with a simulated floor of 13.1 and a ceiling of 40.1. He holds 84% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 22.4% as the captain and 61.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Nico Collins, HOU WR ($10,200 FLEX / $15,300 CPT)

Nico Collins holds 16.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,300 and the 17.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.4 targets on 27.7 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Collins averaged 17.2 points with a simulated floor of 3.7 and a ceiling of 42.2. He holds 54% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.7% as the captain and 36.9% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: David Montgomery, HOU RB ($8,200 FLEX / $12,300 CPT)

David Montgomery holds 16.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $12,300 and the 15.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 20.3 carries and 2.1 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Montgomery averaged 15.5 points with a simulated floor of 4.0 and a ceiling of 33.5. He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.1% as the captain and 41.0% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Colts vs Texans

Jonathan Taylor, IND RB ($10,600 FLEX / $15,900 CPT)

Across 100,000 simulations Taylor averaged 15.4 points with a simulated floor of 4.3 and a ceiling of 32.7. He holds 51% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.8% as the captain and 39.1% in a FLEX spot.

Daniel Jones, IND QB ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

Daniel Jones carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.7 DraftKings points for an $8,800 FLEX salary ($13,200 at captain). Across 100,000 simulations Jones averaged 12.7 points with a simulated floor of 7.6 and a ceiling of 23.8. He holds 40% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.5% as the captain and 37.9% in a FLEX spot.

Tyler Warren carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.8 DraftKings points for an $8,400 FLEX salary ($12,600 at captain). The model gives him 9.8 targets on 30.8 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Warren averaged 11.7 points with a simulated floor of 1.2 and a ceiling of 29.3. He holds 36% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 9.3% as the captain and 27.2% in a FLEX spot.

Xavier Hutchinson, HOU WR ($6,200 FLEX / $9,300 CPT)

Across 100,000 simulations Hutchinson averaged 9.7 points with a simulated floor of 2.6 and a ceiling of 22.0. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.9% as the captain and 28.0% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Schultz averaged 9.6 points with a simulated floor of 0.7 and a ceiling of 25.1. He holds 35% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.4% as the captain and 29.9% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Laquon Treadwell, IND WR ($4,000 FLEX / $6,000 CPT)

Laquon Treadwell projects for 6.5 DraftKings points at a $4,000 FLEX salary, 1.62 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 4.4 targets on 25.0 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Treadwell averaged 6.5 points with a simulated floor of -0.2 and a ceiling of 18.6. He holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.3% as the captain and 18.3% in a FLEX spot.

Colts vs Texans DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Colts vs Texans DraftKings Showdown?

C.J. Stroud holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 22.4%, ahead of Nico Collins (16.7%) and David Montgomery (16.1%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Colts vs Texans?

Build around Nico Collins at captain with C.J. Stroud, David Montgomery and Ka'imi Fairbairn at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (214 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $11,100 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Colts vs Texans DraftKings Showdown?

C.J. Stroud leads the SPAGS model at 20.7 DraftKings points for $10,000 at FLEX, or 31.0 points at captain for $15,000.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Colts vs Texans Showdown?

Jonathan Taylor is the most expensive player at $10,600 FLEX and $15,900 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Colts vs Texans DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Dalton Schultz (9.6 points at $4,800), Laquon Treadwell (6.5 points at $4,000) and Kayshon Boutte (7.6 points at $5,000).

What is the Colts vs Texans spread and total?

The Texans are a 12.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 44.5, with implied team totals of 28.5 for the Texans and 16 for the Colts.
